run_detokenize_files: run the detok script to detokenize one or more text files using MosesDetokenizer
run_detokenize_compressed: run the detok script on compressed input files with automatic decompression support
run_detokenize_stdin: run the detok script with no file arguments to detokenize text from stdin
run_detokenize_clean_artifacts: run the detok script to detokenize text and clean up subword artifacts like @ and = symbols
run_detokenize_fix_dashes: run the detok script to detokenize text and fix spaced en-dash characters
